description: This file defines a modules client for a dashboard frontend, providing functions to fetch module overviews and metrics from a backend API, including URL resolution, data fetching, and data normalization.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Resolves the base URL for API calls, prioritizing environment variables, heuristics, and fallback to localhost.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a URL with optional credentials, handling organization ID and error cases.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Normalizes various data shapes into an array.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches a dashboard overview, attempting multiple endpoints, and deriving minimal data if endpoints are unavailable.

methods.name: getOverviewMetrics
methods.description: Fetches consolidated total metrics for the dashboard overview.
